channel.title: Paksh: Society
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: RJ Mitte's Mother Urges Awareness After 'Breaking Bad' Star's Death
item.description: The mother of actor RJ Mitte, known for his role in 'Breaking Bad', has urged parents to be vigilant for warning signs following his death. Co-star Aaron Paul shared a video of Mitte and recalled their last meeting. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: World's Oldest Shipwreck Discovered Off Turkish Coast
